parties: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited
headline: KCP Sugar: Regulation 29(2) Disclosure under SEBI Takeovers Regulations
sum: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited has filed a Regulation 29(2) disclosure with NSE and BSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or acquisition event.
implication: A Regulation 29(2) disclosure indicates substantial acquisition crossing the 25% threshold or an open offer trigger; verify the acquirer identity, consideration, and whether an open offer is mandated or whether exemptions (e.g., preferential allotment or consolidation) apply.
detail: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited, a listed entity on NSE and BSE, has made a formal disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a person acquires 25% or more of voting rights or shares in a listed company, or when control changes hands. The filing was made on 21 August 2026. The specific acquirer, acquisition percentage, consideration, and whether an open offer is triggered await confirmation from the detailed disclosure document (Form A or B under Regulation 29).
